messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a list of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates that fall on a weekday will create a long weekend if you take the adjacent weekend days off):

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend (if you take adjacent days off) |
|---------|-------------|-------------|----------------------------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Sunday | No extra day needed – already a weekend |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Monday | Long weekend (Feb 18‑20) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | Friday | Long weekend (Apr 7‑9) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | Monday | Long weekend (May 20‑22) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Saturday | No extra day needed – already a weekend |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | Monday | Long weekend (Sep 2‑4) |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 (Monday) | Monday | Long weekend (Oct 7‑9) |
| Remembrance Day (observed) | Nov 11 (Monday) | Monday | Long weekend (Nov 9‑11) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | Monday | Long weekend (Dec 23‑25) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | Tuesday | Long weekend (Dec 24‑26) |

**Note:** Some provinces observe different holidays (e.g., Family Day in British Columbia is on the third Monday in February, which was Feb 27 in 2023). If you’re planning for a specific province, adjust accordingly.
